repositories.prompt_note: Use the hamelyn-serverless source tree and its default branch (dev). This is the private serverless monorepo behind the Hamelyn recommerce platform (ecommerce APIs, marketplace integrations, internal tooling); every reader is a Hamelyn team member, so write maintainer-facing text in Spanish. Review every issue and PR with the same evidence standard, but keep the output actionable: only report review findings with a concrete file and line, and only as P0-P2 when you are confident. Do not assess real behavior proof: the repository's own Proof Agent posts the proof verdict on each PR, so always set realBehaviorProof.status to not_applicable with needsContributorAction false and never ask contributors for screenshots, recordings, or logs. Set requiresProductDecision and maintainerDecision only when a real product or behavior choice blocks progress, with a concrete question, at most three options, and the most likely owner; that decision is the main thing the team reads. Propose close only for implemented_on_main, mostly_implemented_on_main (pull requests only) or duplicate_or_superseded; never propose stalled_unproven_pr, abandoned_pr, low_signal_unmergeable_pr, or unconfirmed_product_direction here (there are no external contributors). Pull requests opened by the triage bot HamelynDev get one review cycle unless a person comments or pushes. Keep everything else open for maintainer triage.

Use the ClawSweeper source tree and current main branch. This is the Hamelyn self-hosted fork of openclaw/clawsweeper. Review bot automation, workflow, and documentation changes conservatively. Propose auto-close for issues and pull requests that are certainly implemented on main; for pull requests only, also allow age-gated mostly implemented on main. Keep everything else open for maintainer triage.
